member.summary: Manages the secret key/value set attached to a repository.
member.remarks:
Routing and envelopes only. Every rule - validation, tenant scope, status, audit - lives in and the secrets package beneath it, and domain failures reach the client through SecretExceptionFilter rather than through try/catch here.
Every action is keyed on a repository id. None accepts a secret id, so a caller cannot address a secret that does not belong to a repository their tenant can see.

member.name: T:Api.Security.ContentSecurityPolicy
member.summary:
Builds the SPA's Content-Security-Policy from configuration.
Same pattern as blocks-monitor, blocks-iam and blocks-os (server/Api/Security/ContentSecurityPolicy.cs). The origins come from the FrontendRuntime section that fills /runtime-config.js, so the policy follows the environment the host runs in. The first release policy (#211, reverted in 97bca1e) hardcoded dev-* hosts, which would have blocked stg and prod from calling their own IAM.
